77822.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Is bitcoin's rally the real turnaround? Bernstein thinks so
77822.body:
Strategy shares hit two-month high as STRC rebounds toward $100 alongside bitcoin | South Korea's Shinhan partners with Solana Foundation, Etherfuse, Orca for tokenized fund issuance | Anchorage CEO says AI agents need bank accounts for 'The Jetsons'-like future | MANTRA freezes all transactions and network following incident |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented by:

JPEG Trading ( https://x.com/jpegtrading?lang=en&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Friday 🎉 Are we so back? *Bitcoin* is flirting with $80,000 after its strongest weekly rally in years, as a historic short squeeze and improving macro sentiment reignite the crypto market.

In today's newsletter, *Bernstein* says *bitcoin's* surge toward $80,000 points to a liquidity-driven momentum shift, *Strategy* shares hit a two-month high with its *bitcoin* back in the black, *Shinhan* partners with the *Solana Foundation* for tokenized fund issuance, and more.

Meanwhile, inside the Oval Office meeting, *President Trump* appeared "bullish" on the *Clarity Act* as he solicited feedback from crypto and finance CEOs, Sarah Wynn reports ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-20-inside-oval-office-meeting-trump-bullish-clarity-act-solicits-feedback-crypto-finance-ceos-412340?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ).

*P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Standard Chartered's year-end bitcoin price prediction* later in the newsletter.

*THE BIG ONE*

*📈 Bitcoin surge toward $80,000 points to liquidity-driven momentum shift as ETF flows rebound: Bernstein*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-08-21-bitcoin-surge-80k-liquidity-driven-momentum-shift-etf-flows-rebound-bernstein-412443?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Bernstein* said *bitcoin's* two-day surge toward $80,000 could mark a broader momentum shift, driven by improving liquidity, rebounding ETF demand, and a friendlier regulatory backdrop.

* Bitcoin hit as high as $79,500 Friday before easing to around $77,000, a rally the analysts tied to the U.S. Treasury's plans to double the size of its longer-dated debt buybacks to $4 billion per operation.
* The analysts said bitcoin historically reacts well to such liquidity expansion, and expect more of it to flow into the asset as a hedge as AI spending increasingly taps debt markets.
* Spot bitcoin ETF flows have also turned, drawing $1.6 billion in net inflows this week, including $606.3 million on Thursday alone, led by *BlackRock's IBIT* , after some $7 billion in outflows over May and June.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Greed is back. A surprise US Treasury buyback expansion torched over $4.5B in shorts and rocketed Bitcoin to $77K — its best week since 2023 — dragging ETFs, corporate treasuries and altcoins along for a euphoric, risk-on ride. 🚀 Bitcoin Tops $77K in Its Best Week Since 2023 Bitcoin surged past $77,000 on Friday — briefly nearing $80,000 — capping a roughly 24% five-day run, its strongest weekly advance since March 2023. The rally ignited Wednesday after the US Treasury said it would at least double its long-dated bond buybacks to $4 billion per operation, driving yields lower and pulling traders back into risk assets. More than $4.5 billion in bearish derivatives positions were liquidated across the week. Read full story 🏦 Bitcoin & Ether ETFs Pull In Record August Inflows US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $608 million on Thursday, lifting weekly inflows above $1.6 billion and pushing August's total to a 2026 high of roughly $2.07 billion. Spot Ether ETFs logged $221 million — their largest single-day intake since October — as institutional demand rushed back alongside the price breakout. More details 💰 Strategy Swings to a $1.4B Bitcoin Profit Michael Saylor's Strategy is back in the black on its 840,447 BTC after the price cleared its roughly $75,385 average cost, flipping a summer paper loss that had topped $13 billion into an unrealized gain of about $1.4 billion. MSTR shares jumped as much as 6–8% to a two-month high, with the firm signaling it plans to resume buying before year-end. Read more 🚨 MANTRA Chain Halts After Exploit as OM Hits Record Low The MANTRA blockchain stopped producing blocks late Thursday and froze all transactions, deposits, withdrawals and bridge operations after an attacker exploited a vulnerability in an upstream software dependency. The native OM token cratered to an all-time low near $0.0041 before partially recovering, with validators staying offline while developers prepare a patched release. See details ⚖️ CFTC Vows to Write Crypto Rules if the CLARITY Act Fails CFTC Chair Michael Selig told industry executives the agency is ready to use its existing authority to draft market-structure rules on its own if Congress can't pass the CLARITY Act this year. 77810.subject: $1B Short Squeeze Rockets BTC
77810.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

GM and happy Friday! 

What a week to be in crypto. Bitcoin ripped 18% higher over the last 48 hours, unleashing a massive short squeeze that wiped out over $1B in positions. Between Trump’s White House crypto comments, the strongest ETF inflows since May and macro maneuvers from the US Treasury, the bulls are back in force. 

Meanwhile, the L2 wars are entering a new phase. Robinhood Chain’s explosive honeymoon launch is facing its first real test as Base rebounds. Let’s dive into what’s moving the markets and who’s winning the fight for L2 dominance.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

BTC is up 18% in just 2 days, and in a space where nearly every asset is a high-beta play on the orange coin, that kind of move tends to ripple violently through the rest of the market (but not the TradFi ones).

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/413b2e7d-6be0-4eeb-b263-117a4e685299/image.png?t=1787301738)
Caption: 

Perps lead the way, up over 28% on the week. This was largely driven by comments from President Trump at the White House crypto meeting, where he said that the CFTC was working to bring Hyperliquid to the US. As mentioned in yesterday’s issue, there was another reason for the broad-based move: the SEC’s proposed rulemaking for [Regulation Crypto Assets](https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2026-76-sec-proposes-new-regulation-crypto-assets). 

There was also a reprieve when the US Treasury said it would at least [double](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/treasury-doubles-long-term-bond-130635805.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) the size of its long-term government debt buybacks. A surprise move that came at a time of growing strains in the $32T US Treasury market. The administration may be getting nervous about the long end of the curve and clearly wants to stem the decline. The interest expense on US debt hit $1.4T; that’s more than BTC was worth yesterday. Speaking of, let’s turn our attention back to the market leader. 

BTC ETF inflows recorded the highest daily print since May 2026. At this rate, it will also be the largest weekly print since May. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ce0a1ef9-bdff-43ec-a031-53e90228fd9f/image.png?t=1787301738)
Caption: 

Liquidation data points to a short squeeze in the mix. More than $1B of BTC shorts were liquidated across Binance, Bybit, OKX a
